lines.en: : Is that too selfish of me?! Am I being punished for simply {i}wanting{/i} something?!
lines.zh: : 这算太自私了吗？！难道我只是{i}想{/i}要点什么，就该受到惩罚吗？！

lines.en: : I love you just as much as them, Noriko...
lines.zh: : 我爱你的程度不输给她们，Noriko……
: 真的吗，不过？……

lines.en: : Because sometimes it feels like we would have ended up together faster if I hadn’t spent all of those years improving myself and just flat-out broke instead.
lines.zh: : 因为有时候我觉得，如果我没把那些年都花在提升自己上，而是干脆彻底崩溃掉，我们反而会更早在一起。
: Noriko……别这么说。

lines.en: : Is that what you want, Akira? Is that the key to your heart? I need to give up the only original pieces of myself that still remain and just let you mold me yourself? Tell me.
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗，Akira？那就是打开你心门的钥匙吗？我必须放弃自己身上仅剩的那几块原始的部分，任由你把我捏成你想要的样子？告诉我。

lines.en: : I want you...to stay exactly the way you are.
lines.zh: : 我要你……就保持现在这个样子。
: 可是为什么？

lines.en: : The way I am isn’t what you want. If it was, we’d be able to make it through one special moment without pulling apart.
lines.zh: : 现在的我并不是你想要的。如果是的话，我们至少能撑过某一个特别的瞬间，而不至于分崩离析。

lines.en: : Because you’re one of the only bright spots in my life.
lines.zh: : 因为你是我人生中仅有的几处光。

lines.en: : Then either you’re lying right to my face or you just love the dark.
lines.zh: : 那要么你是在当面骗我，要么你根本就是喜欢黑暗。

lines.en: : I’m not lying. And, believe it or not, I prefer the light.
lines.zh: : 我没有撒谎。而且，信不信由你，我更偏爱光明。

lines.en: : Then tell me what I can do to shine brighter.
lines.zh: : 那就告诉我，我该怎么做才能更亮一点。

lines.en: : Tell me what steps I need to take so that one day, you walk away from someone else for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 告诉我我该走哪几步，才能让你有一天为了{i}我{/i}而离开别人。

lines.en: : Is such a thing possible? Is there even a future out there like that?
lines.zh: : 这种事可能吗？这世上真的存在那样的未来吗？
: 有的。
: 在某个地方。

lines.en: : But the Noriko in that future is one who didn’t change just to get closer to me- it’s one who stuck to her guns and remained true to herself throughout all of the hardships.
lines.zh: : 但那个未来里的 Noriko，不是那个为了靠近我而改变自己的人——而是那个咬定自己的信念、在所有苦难中都忠于自我的人。

lines.en: : But that’s the same thing as saying-
lines.zh: : 可那不就等于在说——

lines.en: : I need you to suffer for me.
lines.zh: : 我需要你为我受苦。
: 我警告过你。

lines.en: : That all I can do is hold you back.
lines.zh: : 说了我能做的只有拖你后腿。

lines.en: : That you’ll be better off just living your life without me.
lines.zh: : 说了我没有你的人生，你会过得更好。

lines.en: : But I’m selfish. And I know I’m holding some of the pieces you need to move on in my hands.
lines.zh: : 可我自私。而且我知道，你继续往前走所需要的一些碎片，正攥在我手里。

lines.en: : I can’t let them go. And I don’t {i}want{/i} to let them go because the idea of a future without you in it scares me...even though I know it would be a million times better for you.
lines.zh: : 我放不开它们。我也不{i}想{/i}放开，因为一个没有你的未来让我害怕……尽管我知道那样的未来对你来说会好上一百万倍。

lines.en: : That’s why I need you to suffer.
lines.zh: : 所以我才需要你受苦。

lines.en: : I need you to sacrifice your happiness and stay addicted to me so I don’t have to feel things I don’t want to feel.
lines.zh: : 我需要你牺牲自己的幸福，继续对我上瘾，这样我就不必去感受那些我不想感受的东西。

lines.en: : That’s a horrible...{i}horrible{/i} thing to ask someone.
lines.zh: : 那是件很过分……{i}很过分{/i}的要求。
: 我知道。我——
: 但我愿意。

lines.en: : You know I will. I’d do anything for you.
lines.zh: : 你知道我会的。为了你我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: : But, like Ami said, everyone has limits. And what happened back there pushed past mine.
lines.zh: : 不过，就像 Ami 说的那样，每个人都有极限。而刚才那件事，已经越过了我的极限。

lines.en: : I need time to get my head back on straight...and re-evaluate some things now that I know what you two are {i}really{/i} like.
lines.zh: : 我需要时间让自己重新清醒过来……也需要在知道了你们俩{i}真正{/i}的样子之后，重新审视一些事。
: 我让你觉得恶心吗？

lines.en: : I’m much more disgusted by what you did to {i}me{/i} than what you did with her.
lines.zh: : 比起你和她做的那些，你对{i}我{/i}做的才让我恶心得多。

lines.en: : I’m a strong girl, Akira- but I’ve never felt more powerless in my life.
lines.zh: : 我是个坚强的女孩，Akira——可我这辈子从没像现在这样无力过。
: 你当时应该拒绝的。
: 我试过了。
: 你应该更努力一点。

lines.en: : She’s a teenage girl just like me. She doesn’t control you. And I don’t know what sort of obligation you {i}think{/i} you have to her, but you don’t.
lines.zh: : 她跟我一样，不过是个十几岁的女孩。她控制不了你。我不知道你{i}觉得{/i}自己对她负有什么样的义务，但你没有。

lines.en: : Ami is like a sister to me. But I swear...if I hear her speak that way to you again?...I...
lines.zh: : Ami 对我来说就像亲妹妹一样。但我发誓……如果我再听到她用那种口气跟你说话？……我……

lines.en: : I don’t really know what I’ll do. But she won’t like it.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定我会做出什么。但她肯定不会喜欢。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you have to go through this, Noriko....I’m sorry I’m {i}putting{/i} you through this.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉你得承受这些，Noriko……我很抱歉让你{i}承受{/i}这些的人是我。

lines.en: : The Akira Arakawa I know wouldn’t apologize. He’d uncomfortably glance off to the side and then have some deep inner-monologue about what this means for the future.
lines.zh: : 我认识的那个 Akira Arakawa 是不会道歉的。他会不自在地把视线挪到一旁，然后在心里来上一段深刻的内心独白，琢磨这对未来意味着什么。

lines.en: : I don’t...think I know that right now.
lines.zh: : 我……想我现在已经不认识他了。
: 那就想清楚。

lines.en: : And skip the fingering the next time you invite me over.
lines.zh: : 还有，下次你叫我过来的时候，省了用手指那一套。

lines.en: : Because right now, I’m going to go back to the dorm and cry into Kirin’s lap...
lines.zh: : 因为我现在要回宿舍，趴在 Kirin 腿上哭一场……

lines.en: : But as soon as I see you again, I’m going to make you realize you’ve been fucking the wrong little girls this whole time.
lines.zh: : 但等我再见到你，我一定会让你明白，你从头到尾都睡错了小姑娘。
: 明白了吗？
: 很好。
: 我爱你。
: 我也爱你……

lines.en: {i}Uh-oh! Looks like your incestual tendencies have been exposed to someone else!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哎呀！看来你的乱伦癖好被人发现了呢！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Noriko needs some time to recover from the emotional scarring this has caused her, but you’re free to continue having sex with Ami in the meantime!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 需要一些时间来平复这件事给她造成的心灵创伤，不过在此期间，你尽可以继续和 Ami 做爱！{/i}

lines.en: {i}She’s very good at it and her insides feel great!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她技术非常好，里面也舒服得要命！{/i}
{i}简直就像在干一个天使！{/i}
{i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]！{/i}
{i}Ami 的欲望提升到了 [ami_lust]！{/i}
